$comment: Per-exam authoring contract, declared at S3 (exam-author, 2026-08-17). Themes C1-C6 were proposed in derivation/source-tss-mckenzie.md (the T1-T8 architecture starter set cannot be instantiated here: CLF-C02 declares coding, architecture design and troubleshooting out of scope, so no design-judgment theme survives) and are ratified here; theme_definitions carries the one-line judgment each theme exercises. pattern_extensions E01-E06 are the six mechanisms all three Artefact A documents observed that the shared D01-D20 registry does not name (definitions + per-source evidence counts in the Artefact A frequency tables; caps for E01/E06 plus D19/D03/D04 in manifest.validation.pattern_caps). Craft rules S4 must apply (from the Artefact A consequence lists, ratified in derivation/master-inventory.md 'S4 authoring rules'): E02 responsibility-side-flip is a floor not a cap - aim ~10% of wrong options, concentrated on C-017..C-020; E05 cost-model-inversion ~8%, spent on the untested economics concepts (C-012, C-014..C-016), never on another CAPEX/OPEX restatement; E06 is an effective ban - never name an out-of-scope service in any option; negative stems at most one per domain; scenario wrappers only where they change the answer (Tutorials Dojo's bare recall stems are the counterweight precedent); at most one retrieval-tier framing (C-052) and no load-balancer product-line granularity (C-044); canonical names from the guide - Amazon SageMaker AI, Amazon Quick Sight, Amazon WorkSpaces Secure Browser; named E04 sub-forms mapping-permutation (same vocabulary, permuted arrangements) and name-lure (option name shares a stem word, names an unrelated offering) are the corpus's best constructions - use deliberately; both-are-valid multiple response sparingly, second key a legitimate approach; difficulty ceiling = conditional rule over small arithmetic, 1-2 bank items, seated at C-062; option shapes parallel with key length toward the middle of the band (answer-length-cue, L-0015/L-0021); keep C-037/C-064 (Trusted Advisor security vs cost), C-026/C-034 (detect vs protect) and C-040/C-041 (units vs spread) pitched apart. Verticals are authored fresh at S3 as business settings for recognition-altitude scenarios - none is copied from a source scenario, none reused from another exam package.

theme_definitions.C1: Concept identification — name the cloud property, economic idea or model behind a described situation
theme_definitions.C2: Service selection — pick the AWS service that performs the required job, against near neighbours that perform adjacent jobs
theme_definitions.C3: Responsibility placement — decide which side of the shared-responsibility boundary a duty falls on
theme_definitions.C4: Cost and purchasing judgment — choose the pricing model, purchasing option or storage tier a stated constraint implies
theme_definitions.C5: Control selection — pick the security, identity or governance control that meets an obligation
theme_definitions.C6: Where-to-find-it — know which resource, plan, partner or channel supplies a needed thing
